system.description: Though deathknights and most denizens of the Underworld can force the border of a shadowland to obey their will, some necromancers need to move greater numbers of beings between realms. Channeling Essence through the Door-Opening Mudra forces the shadowland to deposit everyone who leaves in either Creation or the Underworld, as the caster chooses. The time of day or the individual's nature no longer matter. Midnight Shadow Sun affects 40 yards of border and ends once the caster is no longer within 100 yards of the spell or after (Essence x 5) minutes.
